message: R.D. Reynolds Tobacco  First I want to thank you for sending out coupons to buy your product. I appreciate the coupons and would like to have more. But even without the coupons, I would buy the Winston cigarettes anyway. I have been smoking Winston since 1969 when I changed from Camel. I changed to the filter cigarettes because of the filter. It was more convenient. I liked the Winston, and when Camel came out with the filter, I didn’t see any reason to change. But really what I want to say is that people are putting up no smoking signs everywhere. Well, I have to go into the public places and pay the same price as everyone else. I don’t mean hazortus places. And if we don’t do something for our rights, then we will give them all away. I am a person the same as anyone else.
